caption: The video captures a close-up of a lit sparkler held at an angle against a deep-blue, layered ribbon-like backdrop. The thin dark stick runs from the lower-left toward the upper-center, terminating in a bright white-yellow burning tip that throws a starburst of glowing sparks in every direction. Throughout the excerpt the tip's core flickers, sometimes flaring into a larger white blob and sometimes tightening. Individual sparks streak outward and vanish at varying positions around it, while the rod tilts slightly and the tip drifts a little near the upper-center, consistent with small handheld movements rather than any deliberate gesture. Falling sparks and short glowing trails appear and disappear lower in the frame, and a soft orange glow spot persists on the right side of the background. The blue ribbons themselves remain essentially stationary, holding the same positions from the first frame to the last.
relations: The burning tip's flickering core emits sparks that streak outward and vanish at varying positions around it.
Small handheld movements cause the rod to tilt slightly and the tip to drift near the upper-center.
Falling sparks and short glowing trails appear and disappear lower in the frame as the tip burns.
A soft orange glow spot persists on the right background while the blue ribbons remain stationary.
